summary:
Airbnb最新季度營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，展現強勁的營運成長動能。
• 營收達36.1億美元，年增率達16.54%
• 每股盈餘（EPS）為1.37美元，優於市場預期的1.25美元
• 獲利表現超越預期幅度達9.48%
ai_view:
觀點：本季財報優於預期傳遞正面訊號，顯示核心旅遊需求具韌性。對短中期股價具支撐作用，但高本益比下需關注未來預訂量成長率與成本控管表現。

需留意：總體經濟環境不確定性可能影響全球旅遊需求；高達38.79的本益比隱含市場對未來成長的高期望

summary_en:
Airbnb reported quarterly revenue and EPS that both beat market expectations, demonstrating robust operational momentum.
• Revenue reached $3.61B, representing a 16.54% YoY increase.
• EPS came in at $1.37, beating the estimated $1.25.
• Earnings surprise achieved a positive 9.48% variance.

View: The beat delivers a positive signal, showing resilient core travel demand. This provides support for near-to-mid-term stock prices, though high valuation requires close monitoring of future booking growth and cost controls.

Watch：Macroeconomic uncertainties could impact global travel demand.; A trailing P/E ratio of 38.79 implies high market expectations for future growth.
